overloads.semanticRole: The METHOD SET COMMENTS command replaces the documentation of the method(s) designated by the path parameter by those specified in the comments parameter.

jointConstraints.rule: path and comments must be passed as the same kind (both scalar Text variables, or both Text arrays of matching length); the two syntaxes cannot be mixed.

constraints: Forms and form methods share the same documentation.
If called from a component you must pass the trailing '*' parameter, because access to the component code is read-only; omitting it in that context generates error -9763.
